sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports summary card parts
sections.what: Brings in the card and badge pieces, the icons and the store.
sections.why: Likely reason: needed to draw the card and read the data it describes.

sections.name: PeriodSummaryReportsProps
sections.title: Accepts the timeframe value
sections.what: Declares that the card receives weekly, monthly or yearly from the parent screen.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the heading name the period the user chose.
sections.watch_out: The value is only used for the heading, so the figures do not change with it.

sections.name: PeriodSummaryReports (part 1)
sections.title: Calculates figures and first highlights
sections.what: Works out focus hours, task completion percent and the average success of active habits. Shows the first two highlight boxes with those figures.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives the main progress numbers in plain sentences.
sections.watch_out: The figures cover all tasks, focus sessions and habits, not only the chosen period.

sections.name: PeriodSummaryReports (part 2)
sections.title: Energy balance highlight
sections.what: Labels burnout risk as low, moderate or high based on the momentum score, and shows it in a warning-coloured box.
sections.why: Likely reason: a quick check on whether the user may be overloading themselves. The thresholds are not explained in the code.
sections.watch_out: This is a rough rule based on one number, not a real measure of burnout.

summary: A summary card with short written highlights on task progress, focus time, and an energy and balance warning.
purpose: Gives a plain-language reading of progress for the selected period.
why: Likely reason: turns the numbers into sentences a non-technical user can read. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Reads the profile, focus sessions, tasks and habits from the store. Calculates the task completion percent, the average success of active habits, total focus hours, and a burnout risk label from the momentum score. Shows the period name in the heading and three highlight boxes.
inputs: Momentum score from the profile, plus focus sessions, tasks and habits from the store. The timeframe value passed from the parent screen.
outputs: A card with a heading, a fixed STEADY EXECUTION badge and three highlight boxes. Nothing is saved.
risks: The figures are totals for all time, not for the selected week, month or year, even though the heading names the period. The burnout label is a rough guess from one score. The badge text never changes.
debug: If a figure looks wrong, check the matching data in the store, such as the status of tasks or habits. If the heading and figures seem to disagree, that is the known mismatch noted above. If the burnout label looks wrong, check the score thresholds in the code.
